final_book_page_4_recheck.finding: The 5×5 diagram uses the actual common backs: 21 visually identical Sea/Rock cells, two palm islands and two single lighthouses. The destination is aligned outside the map; no sixth row or revealed event is implied.

book_findings: Only FOULWAKE on cover; native title is clear.
OKU/YAP panels, repeated table headers and differentiated examples support moderator use.
All 20 character entries fit on page 21; long power entries flow across pages 22–23.
Optional story occupies pages 25–27; quick reference is on page 28.
No blank overflow page; page 30 is an intentional note page for an even duplex count.
imposition_findings: All 23 front/back sheet pairs present; empty final slots mirror correctly.
Poker fronts and backs have complementary rotations for long-edge duplex.
Sheet 12 correctly pairs Erzak with Power back while the remaining five cards use Loyalty backs.
All six island backs are the same sandy palm scene.
All four lighthouse backs contain a single upright tower.
No missing image, overlapping trim or detached duplicate subject was observed.
limits: Digital inspection by the producer; not independent art acceptance.
No physical printer, paper-opacity or color-profile proof.
No human playtest or measured claim that the game became more fun.
No claim that every possible pixel defect can be excluded.
